# F-011 · The orders database has no restore on record inside its RPO window

| Status | Date | Source | Evidence level |
|---|---|---|---|
| confirmed | 2027-07-01 | export | tenant |

**Severity:** P1, because a tier-1 data store may not be recoverable within its RPO. · **Decision:** proposed · **Implementation:** absent · **Verification:** observed.

**What we see.** The last restore of the orders database is dated 2026-10-14, before the
window (E-105). Gap G-11.

**Confidence and limits.** High for the ticket records; restores done outside the ticket system are not seen.

**Why it matters.** A restore never tried is a recovery time nobody knows.

**What follows.** Restore on a schedule and record it. Owner: database team lead. **Model:** sre

**Closing criterion.** A restore inside the RPO, recorded, every quarter.

**Links.** F-014; D-21.
